title: Chaum publishes blind signatures for untraceable payments
detail: Year precision. David Chaum's Crypto 82 paper, printed in the 1983 proceedings, introduces blind signatures, the basis of anonymous digital cash.

title: Millicent proposes broker scrip for sub-cent web payments
detail: Month precision (WWW4, Boston). Digital Equipment Corporation researchers describe vendor-specific scrip validated by the vendor's own server, aimed at purchases under one cent. A companion paper appeared at the First USENIX Workshop on Electronic Commerce in July 1995.

title: Rivest and Shamir present PayWord and MicroMint
detail: Month precision. Presented at the Security Protocols workshop in Cambridge, UK, in April 1996 and published in LNCS 1189 in 1997 (DOI 10.1007/3-540-62494-5_6). PayWord uses hash chains for repeated small payments to one vendor.

title: HTTP/1.1 (RFC 2068) reserves 402 Payment Required for future use
detail: Month precision (January 1997). Section 10.4.3 names the status code and reserves it without defining a payment mechanism.

title: Rivest proposes electronic lottery tickets as micropayments
detail: Month precision (Financial Cryptography 1997, Anguilla). Probabilistic payments let a payer send a ticket that pays a larger amount with small probability, cutting per-payment processing cost.

title: RFC 2616 keeps 402 reserved
detail: Month precision (June 1999). RFC 2616 obsoletes RFC 2068 and keeps 402 Payment Required reserved for future use.

title: Macaroons introduce attenuable bearer credentials with caveats
detail: Month precision (NDSS 2014). Google and academic authors describe chained-HMAC tokens that holders can restrict with caveats. L402 later uses macaroons as its credential format.

title: EMVCo publishes the Payment Tokenisation Specification Technical Framework v1.0
detail: Network tokens replace the card number with a token restricted to a device, merchant or channel. Card-network agent schemes build on this token model. Date from a trade press report; the EMVCo library page was not confirmed directly.

title: Lightning Network white paper draft 0.5.9.2
detail: Joseph Poon and Thaddeus Dryja describe payment channels for off-chain bitcoin payments. This dated draft followed earlier 2015 versions.

title: ERC-735 Claim Holder proposed as a GitHub issue
detail: Fabian Vogelsteller opens ethereum/EIPs issues for ERC-734 Key Manager and ERC-735 Claim Holder, the basis of ONCHAINID. Neither became an EIP file.

title: Lightning Labs starts the LSAT specification
detail: First commit of the LSAT (Lightning Service Authentication Token) repository: macaroon plus Lightning invoice behind HTTP 402.

title: Lightning Labs announces LSAT for paid APIs over HTTP 402
detail: LSAT combines a macaroon credential with a Lightning invoice returned on a 402 response. Aperture, a reverse proxy, implements it.

title: ERC-3643 (T-REX) created
detail: Permissioned token standard with ONCHAINID claims; now Final.

title: RFC 9110 consolidates HTTP semantics and still reserves 402
detail: Month precision (June 2022). Section 15.5.3 keeps 402 (Payment Required) reserved for future use.

title: Lightning Labs renames LSAT to L402 in its specification
detail: A documentation rewrite in the lightninglabs/L402 repository (commit d31479c) replaces LSAT with L402; servers and clients keep accepting both scheme names. Lightning Labs used the L402 name publicly in its 2023-07-06 AI agent tooling announcement.

title: bLIP-0026 L402 drafted
detail: Lightning Labs authors propose L402 to the Lightning bLIP process (PR #26, still open on 2026-10-11).

title: RFC 9421 HTTP Message Signatures and RFC 9530 Digest Fields published
detail: Month precision (February 2024). Both are Standards Track. Visa TAP and other agent schemes sign HTTP requests with RFC 9421.

title: GENIUS Act signed (Public Law 119-27)
detail: First US federal framework for payment stablecoins. It takes effect on the earlier of 2027-01-18 or 120 days after final implementing rules; the OCC's final rule of 2026-10-23 names 2027-01-18 as the effective date. It does not address AI agents as payers.

title: CFPB reopens the open banking rule (section 1033 reconsideration)
detail: The advance notice asks who may act as a consumer's representative, a question that will shape agent access to account data. It is not an agent rule.

title: Canada's Retail Payment Activities Act fully in force
detail: From this date payment service providers must have risk management and funds safeguarding frameworks under Bank of Canada supervision.

title: McKinsey sizes agent-orchestrated commerce at $3 trillion to $5 trillion by 2030
detail: Month precision (October 2025). Forecast; goods only; US B2C $900 billion to $1 trillion.

title: NPCI, Razorpay and OpenAI announce UPI agentic payments pilot
detail: ChatGPT purchases over UPI using Reserve Pay and UPI Circle; pilot with Axis Bank and Airtel Payments Bank.

title: Visa's rules add requirements for agentic payments
detail: The 2025-10-18 edition of the Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules added the Visa Intelligent Commerce program to the rules (effective 2025-11-04 in Chile). The rules govern Visa and its member institutions and yield to applicable law. An Agentic Payment Provider must enroll in the program and register with Visa, and may not combine several agent purchases into one transaction. Within Visa's system, the cardholder is responsible for its actions in an Agentic Transaction as if the cardholder had initiated it. Visa calls none of these agent rules a liability shift.

title: Mastercard reports its first agentic transaction on the network
detail: Said on the Q3 2025 earnings call. A year later Mastercard still published no agent volume, while its CEO described the early stages of consumer adoption (see 2026-10-29).

title: Amazon sues Perplexity over the Comet shopping agent
detail: CFAA and California CDAFA claims plus a preliminary injunction motion, N.D. Cal. No. 3:25-cv-09514.

title: EU reaches provisional agreement on PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation
detail: Political deal between Parliament and Council. The Council adopted its first-reading positions on 2026-10-29 (see that event); as of 2026-11-14 neither act was in the Official Journal. The Council texts have no agent-specific provisions.

title: Morgan Stanley forecasts $190 billion to $385 billion of US agentic e-commerce by 2030
detail: Base and bull cases; date of first press report.

title: Klarna publishes the Agentic Product Protocol
detail: Open product-feed specification and API for AI agents; scale figures are Klarna's own.

title: Bain forecasts $300 billion to $500 billion of US agentic commerce by 2030
detail: 15 to 25 percent of US online retail.

title: Adobe: generative AI referral traffic to US retail sites up 693.4 percent in holiday 2025
detail: Traffic measure, 2025-11-01 to 2025-12-31.

title: Salesforce attributes $262 billion of holiday 2025 online sales to AI and agents
detail: Global influence attribution, not agent-executed payments.

title: NPCI and Razorpay extend UPI agentic payments pilot to Claude
detail: Announced at the India AI Impact Summit with Zomato, Swiggy and Zepto; small user group.

title: bLIP-0026 rewritten to be token-agnostic
detail: Draft adds version="0" and a generic token= parameter; macaroons become RECOMMENDED, not required. Lightning Labs' own repository text still uses macaroon=.

title: A402 paper proposes atomic payment and service
detail: arXiv:2603.01179 argues x402 lacks atomicity across execution, payment and delivery; academic proposal only.

title: US district court enjoins Perplexity's agent from Amazon accounts
detail: Judge Chesney grants Amazon a preliminary injunction with a seven-day administrative stay. The Ninth Circuit stays it on 2026-03-16 pending appeal. Exact dates come from press reports; the appellate opinion says March 2026.

title: Tempo mainnet and MPP released
detail: Tempo launches mainnet and introduces the Machine Payments Protocol, co-authored with Stripe.

title: FCA payments priorities name agentic AI payments
detail: The FCA says it will work with HM Treasury and consider whether payments regulation needs to change to support agentic AI payments.

title: Canada's Stablecoin Act receives Royal Assent in Bill C-15
detail: Part of the Budget 2025 Implementation Act, No. 1 (S.C. 2026, c. 3). The Act was not in force on 2026-10-19 and no commencement order had appeared by 2026-11-14; orders of the Governor in Council will set its commencement. Once in force, the Bank of Canada will supervise issuers. The proposed Stablecoin Regulations of 2026-10-24 say the government intends the framework to take effect in fall 2027.

title: ERC-8226 Regulated Agent Mandate proposed
detail: Draft ERC from Brickken authors: scoped, time-bounded, capped agent authority over regulated tokens, naming ERC-3643 or ERC-7943 and ERC-8004 as adjacent layers.

title: American Express announces Agent Purchase Protection
detail: Issuer commitment to protect eligible Card Members from charges caused by registered AI agent errors, terms apply.

title: x402 adds batch-settlement with the cloudflare:402 network
detail: Credit-backed scheme with RFC 9421 signatures and Cloudflare as merchant of record (PR #1145); separate from the Monetization Gateway beta, which settles USDC on Base.

title: ERC-8226 merged as a Draft
detail: PR #1679 merged into ethereum/ERCs.

title: Keyrock counts $73 million of on-chain agent payments
detail: 176 million transactions from May 2025 to April 2026, nearly all in USDC (date of press coverage).

title: Senator Warner asks Treasury about AI agents in finance
detail: Letter to Treasury Secretary Bessent asks Treasury to examine agentic payment rails and how existing law allocates liability when agents make errors or enable fraud.

title: Ninth Circuit hears Amazon v. Perplexity
detail: Argued and submitted in Seattle; amici include the ACLU, EFF with Mozilla, and the National Retail Federation.

title: MiCA transitional period for crypto-asset service providers ends
detail: Firms without MiCA authorization must stop serving EU clients and run their wind-down plans. Some member states ended the period earlier.

title: Visa and Artemis report adjusts x402 volume to $15.0 million
detail: Excluding identified wash and test activity, x402 carried $15.0 million across 109.6 million transactions from May 2025 to 2026-04-21; raw totals were over $135.7 million across 178.3 million. MPP settled about $25,000 adjusted. Visa's Cuy Sheffield later cited about $19 million across about 134 million adjusted transactions, with no data date (reported).

title: HM Treasury consults on modernising payment services regulation
detail: The consultation (closed 2026-10-06) asks how authentication, consent and liability rules should adapt for agentic payments, alongside tokenised payments and Open Banking.

title: EU Digital Omnibus on AI enters into force
detail: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 moves Annex III high-risk obligations to 2027-12-02 and Annex I to 2028-08-02, and adds a grace period to 2026-12-02 for Article 50(2) marking by existing generative systems.

title: MCP specification revision 2026-07-28 released
detail: The protocol becomes stateless: no initialize handshake or Mcp-Session-Id header, and servers must implement server/discover. The release candidate came out on 2026-05-29.

title: Worldpay: no liability shift yet for agent card payments
detail: Analysis from an acquirer: properly tokenized agent transactions follow existing rules, while liability for disputes short of fraud is unresolved.

title: EU AI Act general application date, including Article 50 transparency
detail: The general date of application of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, kept by the Digital Omnibus. Chatbot-style disclosure duties under Article 50 apply from here.

title: Ninth Circuit vacates the Amazon v. Perplexity injunction
detail: The user, not Perplexity, accessed Amazon using the agent as a tool; Amazon unlikely to succeed under the CFAA or CDAFA on these facts. Remanded.

title: A2A becomes a hosted project of the Agentic AI Foundation
detail: The Linux Foundation directed fund that also hosts MCP; A2A's own post calls it a Growth Stage project.

title: EMVCo publishes a draft framework for card-based agentic payments
detail: Draft for comment until 2026-09-30, proposing Intent Services. EMVCo lists Know Your Agent and Agentic Transaction Indicators as possible future work.

title: Ant International, Mastercard and Visa start Know Your Agent interoperability work
detail: The three will explore common principles across their existing protocols (Visa TAP, Mastercard Verifiable Intent, Ant's Agentic Mobile Protocol), working through the MAS-convened BuildFin.ai platform and building on the SAFR framework. No network rule change announced.

title: Ninth Circuit denies Amazon's petition for rehearing en banc in Amazon v. Perplexity
detail: No judge asked for a vote. The mandate issued on 2026-09-18, so the 2026-08-04 judgment vacating the injunction took effect and the case continued in the district court.

title: NPCI AI-agent registry for UPI reported
detail: Reuters-relayed report of a planned agent registry and framework; no NPCI publication found.

title: Web Monetization draft republished
detail: WICG Draft Community Group Report with Interledger Foundation editors; not a W3C standard. No agent program announced.

title: Amazon amends its complaint against Perplexity with a claim based on its Agent Terms
detail: The First Amended Complaint keeps the CFAA and CDAFA counts and adds tortious interference with contractual relations, resting on the Agent Terms that Amazon added to its Conditions of Use on 2025-05-30. Those terms require an agent to identify itself, including in its user agent string, a self-declared label rather than a signed identity.

title: OpenAI introduces dots, always-on ChatGPT agents with their own cloud computer and browser
detail: As documented on 2026-11-14, dots are rolling out gradually to eligible Pro and Business Premium accounts and are available in eligible Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces; they became the first surface for ChatGPT Wallet on 2026-11-13.

title: Sierra announces Personal Agent Protocol with Meta
detail: An open standard for how a personal agent finds a company, starts a session and signs its user in; first industry partners Genesys, Instinct, Rocket, Shopify, Stripe and Walmart.

title: MAS issues Guidelines on AI Risk Management
detail: Effective 2027-10-07, with some expectations phased to 2028-10-07. MAS plans to consult on more agentic AI guidance in 2027.

title: ERC-8226 adds per-asset mandates
detail: Mandates keyed by agent, principal and asset (PR #2060). Still Draft.

title: Observed: x402.org counter unchanged, 8004scan passes 561,000 registrations
detail: x402.org still showed 75.41M transactions and $24.24M under its Last 30 Days counter, values unchanged since at least 2025-12-14 (Wayback Machine); the counter was gone by 2026-11-14. 8004scan showed 561,614 agents across 30 networks (the ERC-8004 contracts README lists 25 mainnets). MPPscan's home page showed 127.4K transactions for its default 7-day window.

title: Perplexity moves to dismiss Amazon's amended complaint
detail: The motion to dismiss and stay discovery is set for hearing on 2026-11-20 before Judge Chesney; trial is set for 2027-09-27. No ruling as of 2026-11-14.

title: American Express publishes its Intent Intelligence framework
detail: A Create Intent API, an Intent ID and a Proof of Intent Token (a JSON Web Token) that can scope the agent's payment credential to the authenticated intent; part of the ACE Developer Kit, whose program page lists the Intent Intelligence specification as available since 2026-04-14.

title: EBA classifies USDC as the first significant e-money token under MiCA
detail: USDC, issued in the EU by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS, is under the dual supervision MiCA sets for significant e-money tokens from 2026-11-12: the EBA directly supervises own funds, the reserve of assets, liquidity and recovery and redemption plans, and the French ACPR keeps governance and the other areas.

title: FCA says it will develop a trusted framework for agentic finance
detail: In a speech, the FCA's chief data, information and intelligence officer said the FCA will work with industry, other regulators and frontier labs on agent identity, delegated authority, accountability and execution. A companion page of AI good-practice examples says it creates no new requirements. No rule or consultation had followed by 2026-11-14.

title: World deprecates and archives AgentKit
detail: Repository marked deprecated (pull request 44) and archived, with no replacement named; by 2026-11-14 the docs overview answered 404 and the integration page redirected to Agent Pass.

title: OCC publishes the first primary-regulator final rule under the GENIUS Act
detail: Announced on 2026-10-21 and published as FR Doc. 2026-21706 (91 FR 67000), the rule covers payment stablecoin issuers under the OCC's jurisdiction and takes effect on 2027-01-18, together with the Act. The OCC calls it the first final rule from a primary federal payment stablecoin regulator; Treasury's procedural interim final rule on state certifications came earlier, on 2026-09-30. Bank Secrecy Act, AML and sanctions rules follow in a separate rulemaking. It has no provision on AI agents. No FDIC, Federal Reserve, NCUA or Treasury final rule implementing the Act had followed by 2026-11-14.

title: Canada prepublishes proposed Stablecoin Regulations
detail: Proposed, not final: issuer rules under the Stablecoin Act, and payment service providers that perform payment functions with stablecoins from listed issuers would come under the Retail Payment Activities Act. The government intends the rules to take effect in fall 2027, with the Act; comments were invited for 60 days.

title: Mastercard CEO describes early consumer use of agentic payments, with no volume given
detail: On the Q3 2026 earnings call (third-party transcript) Michael Miebach said consumers are in the early stages of adopting agentic commerce but the numbers are not yet significant, that Shopify's Shop Pay is using Agent Pay and Mastercard network tokens, and that a broad partnership signed with OpenAI that quarter includes the use of Agent Pay. Mastercard's written results give no agent figures. Shopify itself says only that Shop Pay agent purchases from merchants off Shopify use Mastercard, Visa and Discover tokens (2026-10-28), without naming Agent Pay.

title: Council adopts its first-reading positions on PSD3 and the Payment Services Regulation
detail: Both files await the European Parliament's second reading (indicative plenary 2026-12-14) and are not yet in the Official Journal. Most PSR rules would apply 21 months after entry into force, when PSD3 must also apply. Neither text has an AI-agent provision; a PSR recital says strong customer authentication applies when a merchant-initiated mandate is set up, not to each later merchant-initiated payment.

title: Web Bot Auth working group draft -01 posted
detail: Every Signature-Agent value becomes an HTTPS URL that the verifier fetches directly as a JWK Set; the directory, jwks_uri and cimd types are removed. Deployed signers and verifiers still use the earlier string form.

title: UK regulators publish a joint statement on protecting people in an agentic economy
detail: The members of the Digital Regulation Cooperation Forum (CMA, FCA, ICO and Ofcom) set out their work on agentic AI and how existing law applies to agents, as described on the CMA's GOV.UK pages (the statement itself was not readable). The CMA's guidance says a business answers for what its AI agent does as it would for an employee. A statement, not a rule.

title: OCC examiner framework puts an autonomous customer-facing payment agent in its highest risk tier
detail: OCC Bulletin 2026-54 gives examiners a framework for banks' use of super intelligence, the federal term for AI since Executive Order 14434 (published 2026-10-02). A fully autonomous, customer-facing payment agent sits in Tier 1 (critical), and agentic-commerce systems outside the bank's control are treated as a channel risk. The framework says it sets no supervisory expectations for banks: it is guidance, not a rule.

title: Cloudflare adds per-agent controls for personal agents
detail: AI bot policies renamed AI Crawler and Agent access policies, with Allow, Block on pages with ads or Block for each supported personal agent and a Personal Assistants traffic category.

title: Cloudflare announces the Trusted Agent Delegation coalition
detail: Meant to examine existing protocols and bring well-defined problems to the IETF; World's post of 2026-11-12 presents it as a Cloudflare and World coalition. A whitepaper, no specification or member list (as of 2026-11-14).

title: MCP moves to a six-month release cycle
detail: Releases generally on the last Tuesday of March and September; the next revision is targeted for 2027-03-30, a plan rather than a release.

title: ChatGPT Wallet launches in dots for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers
detail: Built with American Express, Mastercard and Visa: the user approves each purchase with a security check, and the card network supplies a payment token that the dot enters in the merchant's existing checkout. OpenAI does not present Wallet as ACP; its post quotes American Express calling Wallet its first ACE integration.

title: Personal Agent Protocol 1.0 released
detail: Sierra announces version 1.0 with more than 100 design partners and a UCP extension that Shopify co-authored; the project's changelog dates the frozen 1.0 text 2026-11-14. The core specification does not cover payments yet; through the UCP extension, payment runs in UCP checkout.

title: Observed: x402.org counter gone, 8004scan passes 2 million registrations, MPPscan indexer appears stalled
detail: x402.org no longer shows its Last 30 Days counter, which a capture of 2026-10-24 still had. 8004scan's statistics API counts 2,062,896 agents, about three times the 699,098 of 2026-10-18, mostly from two batch waves on Base and Arc Mainnet whose sampled registrations all point to Central City; it does not index 0G, whose registry had issued ids up to 3,941,206, so on-chain registrations across chains exceed 6 million by highest id. MPPscan's newest indexed transaction dates from 2026-11-11T17:14:56Z while Tempo kept producing blocks, so its indexer appears to have stopped and its rolling windows cover fewer days than their labels say.

title: GENIUS Act and the OCC's implementing rule take effect (scheduled)
detail: Eighteen months after enactment. The OCC's final rule (published 2026-10-23) takes effect the same day and names it as the Act's effective date; final rules issued after about 2026-09-20 could not bring the date earlier, because 120 days would fall after 2027-01-18.
